  --resources i-0abcd1234efgh5678 \
  --tags Key=Environment,Value=Production Key=Team,Value=Platform
caption: One or more resource IDs, one or more Key=...,Value=... pairs, applied in one call.
--tag-specifications tags the instance in the same command that creates it.
--filters narrows which instances come back, before --query reshapes the result.
